blocks.content: Introduction to Maintenance record elements (Part 43.9 level)
Identify required elements of a maintenance record/log entry.

items.definition: Per 14 CFR §43.9, a maintenance record must include: description of work performed, date completed, name of person performing work, certificate number, and a return-to-service signature.
items.analogy: Like a doctor's note after surgery — it must say what was done, when, by whom with their license number, and that the patient is cleared to go.

items.definition: Required elements per §43.9: description of work performed, parts used, date completed, technician name, certificate number, and return-to-service statement.
items.analogy: Like a contractor's invoice that doubles as a warranty record — documenting exactly what was done, what was installed, when, and by whom with their license number.

blocks.question: Per 14 CFR §43.9, which elements must be included in a maintenance record entry?
choices: Description of work, date, name, certificate number, and return-to-service signature
Description of work, aircraft serial number, date, and inspector signature
Work order number, date, technician photo ID, and certificate number
Part numbers replaced, date, flight hours, and technician name
blocks.feedback: §43.9 requires five elements: description of work performed, date completed, name, certificate number, and return-to-service signature. Aircraft serial number, flight hours, and photo ID are not required elements.

blocks.question: Which list correctly states all required elements of a maintenance log entry for an avionics repair?
choices: Description of work performed, parts used, date completed, technician name, certificate number, and return-to-service statement
Description of work, aircraft serial number, date, and IA countersignature
Work order number, parts used, technician name, and shop authorization stamp
Description of work, date, parts used, and return-to-service signature only
blocks.feedback: All six elements are required by §43.9. Aircraft serial number and IA countersignature are not required elements. Work order number and shop stamp are administrative tools, not regulatory requirements.
